description: This file defines classes for parsing and representing expression trees in a workflow engine, including token handling, parsing expressions with logical conditions, and building expression trees.

classes.name: VTExpressionTreeNode
classes.description: Represents a node in an expression tree, encapsulating an array of parameters or sub-nodes.

classes.name: VTExpressionSymbol
classes.description: Wraps a symbol value used within expressions, providing string representation.

classes.name: VTExpressionParser
classes.description: Parses token streams into expression trees, supporting logical constructs, operator precedence, and nested expressions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes nodes with provided data or tokens.

methods.name: getParams
methods.description: Returns parameters of the expression node, excluding the first element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name or type of the expression node.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Provides string representation of a symbol instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with a token stream and sets up internal queue.

methods.name: nextToken
methods.description: Retrieves the next token, either from the token queue or by advancing the token stream.

methods.name: la
methods.description: Looks ahead in the token stream without consuming tokens.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Consumes a token with expected label and value, throws exception if mismatch.

methods.name: consumeSymbol
methods.description: Consumes a symbol token with a specific symbol.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if a token matches a given label and value.

methods.name: checkSymbol
methods.description: Checks if a token is a specific symbol.

methods.name: atom
methods.description: Parses atomic expressions such as literals, symbols, or parenthesized expressions.

methods.name: ifCondition
methods.description: Parses an 'if' conditional expression, handling nested 'if's, and returning a tree node.

methods.name: expression
methods.description: Parses expressions, including function-like calls, conditionals, or binary operations based on lookahead.

methods.name: binOp
methods.description: Parses binary operations with precedence handling.

methods.name: binOpPrec
methods.description: Recursive helper for parsing binary operations at a specific precedence level.

methods.name: unaryOp
methods.description: Parses unary operators and operands, including '+' and '-'.
